WITH rating_stock AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS films_in_stock
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT films_in_stock,
         films_in_stock - AVG(films_in_stock) OVER () AS above_by
  FROM rating_stock
  WHERE films_in_stock > (SELECT AVG(films_in_stock) FROM rating_stock)
)
SELECT SUM(films_in_stock) AS total_films_in_stock,
       AVG(above_by) AS average_above_rating_average
FROM above_average
